_about: Export presets per UAE authority (report C15, researched 2026-10-30). Each value has a 'src' (report source number, see reports/C15-municipal-submission-and-drawing-standards.md#sources) or 'src': 'choice' when the authority publishes nothing and the value is a Choices made default. Nothing here is an authority-approved template.

drawingFormat.value: DWF (only DWF accepted in the Drawings attachment category; Documents accept any format)

scaleNote.value: one 'scale size' is selected per drawings attachment set and should be the same for all drawings

crs.value: EPSG:3997 (WGS 84 / Dubai Local TM) for any georeferenced CAD

pdf.value: PDF/A-2b layered review copy (not a DM requirement)

presets.authority: Dubai Municipality (master plan approval, Planning Department)

drawingFormat.value: MicroStation V7 DGN, 2D, DLTM, prepared to 'DM Digital Data Delivery - General Standards' (copy from the DM project coordinator)

tables.value: development control tables (use, allotment area, GFA, envelope, parking) + Excel file of the formulas used

layerMap.value: per DM Digital Data Delivery standard (not public)

presets.authority: Dubai Development Authority (preliminary / final design, building permit)

drawingFormat.value: DWF, one sheet per file (combined files rejected)

colour.value: black and white / monochrome, except perspectives and Shaded Area Diagrams

areaSheet.value: A-03-XXX Shaded Area Diagram (Area Calculation Sheet), coloured; third-party survey adds AutoCAD + polyline diagram

dwgVersion.value: AC1024 for the AutoCAD polyline file

crs.src: choice (DDA states DLTM for master-plan GIS data [3])

presets.authority: Dubai Development Authority (master plan PMP / SOS / FMP)

reportFormat.value: single PDF ('version 7 or later'), colour, legible at A4, no password or restrictions, uncompressed files

gisFormat.value: MicroStation DGN, real coordinates in metres, WGS 1984 Dubai Local TM (DLTM)

plotNumbering.value: {ProjectInitial}-{Zone}-{000} (e.g. MU-A-001); FC / UT / OS for facility, utility, open-space plots

tables.value: Land Use Budget sheet in Excel (DDA template)

plans.value: scale bar, north arrow with Qibla direction, site boundary, dimensions in metres

presets.authority: Abu Dhabi DMT / ADM Spatial Data Division (planning data: plot, roads, service corridors)

portal.value: submission to UPD/SDD; ADM QC tool (.fas) checks before upload

crs.value: WGS 84 / UTM zone 40N (EPSG:32640); zone 39 parameters also listed

layerMap.note: [ACI colour, lineweight mm]; Roads and Services files have their own tables

geometry.value: closed LWPOLYLINE only; no arcs, splines, ellipses, hatches, solids, xrefs, lines; no elevation, width or 3D; attribute block inside its polygon

titleBlock.value: 'Title' attribute block, consultant and/or contractor name in English (one is mandatory)

presets.authority: Trakhees (PCFC) Civil Engineering Department (concept design, building permit, master plan NOC)

portal.value: online.trakhees.ae; CPR system for master plans

documentFormat.value: all documents in PDF, uploaded into folder codes GD, STR, ARCH, HVAC, GB, FP

areaSheet.value: area calculation sheet in DWF including floor polylines

cadFormat.value: PDF and AutoCAD in DLTM coordinates (utilities route NOC)

layerMap.value: AIA/NCS names; approved vs revised utilities on separate layers
